contractual_dependencies.effect: No judgment floor, semantic-independence exception or gate is weakened by engineering tests.
Qualified counsel and owner-labelled evidence must assess support, applicability, inference, opposition, communication and verifier error in both directions.
Missing historical section text, force, treatment or binding evidence stays NOT_ASSESSED; model knowledge cannot fill it.
Approved ledger-bound runs must meet absolute quality bars for each turn kind/provider and measure cost before relative comparison or cutover.
Local extraction receives admitted bytes only. It does not admit quarantine, configure malware scanners, process raw AV or permit off-premises media.
Required shared checks, permissions, versioned acceptance and accountable approvals must pass. Contract coverage is not release authority.

local_test_observations.scope: 20 controlled foundation test files, including readiness, extraction, catalogue, atomic writes, actual private review, final assessment and research context
local_test_observations.reservation: Not a pre/post pinned canonical acceptance artifact across parallel edits. Module measurement and every clause acceptance artifact therefore remain NOT_RUN.
Local real-journal controls, not expert-quality evaluation or publication/cutover evidence.
